policy.candidate_input: M1.7 primary exact, M1.8c approved provisional chemical structure IDs
policy.one_exact_observation: provisional unreplicated label; assay not confirmed
policy.repeat_estimator: median of provenance-key medians, not proof of independent evidence
policy.censored_conflicts: contradictory determinate censored activity vetoes exact regression label
policy.construct_assays: plain target names only; no sequence or endpoint confirmation
policy.ambiguous_censored_records: not used as exact regression labels
policy.duplicate_sources: all records retained; apparent duplicate signatures flagged

limitations: Every regression label is provisional: neither reference EGFR/HER2 sequence nor biochemical assay endpoint is verified at record level.
Single-observation labels are unreplicated, not necessarily reliable ground truth.
A provenance_key is a publication/patent grouping, not an independent lab or assay ID.
Accepted repeats only agree within an empirical 0.30 pIC50 range; this is a policy choice, not a universally established measurement error threshold.
Censored evidence is used only to flag contradictory activity; censored values are never converted to exact regression pIC50.
No salts, tautomers, protein constructs or source-linked chemistry are silently merged.
No train/test split, baseline model, GNN, or external validation has occurred.
